axis_1_base_rank_over_Qt.achieved_evidence: 8 sections exhibited over Q(t) and verified symbolically on the reduced family; 8x8 Neron-Tate regulator nonsingular at t in {-1,-7,7/5,11/3,3} (least eigenvalue > 0.3), singular at t in {1,2,1/2,5}
axis_1_base_rank_over_Qt.ceiling_reason: a pencil of plane cubics through 8 points is a RATIONAL elliptic surface; MW rank over Qbar(t) is at most 8
axis_1_base_rank_over_Qt.published_record_base_rank_reference: roughly 18-20 (Elkies-class constructions on higher elliptic surfaces); cited as background, not measured here

axis_2_sieve_volume.binding_cost_measured: 2-descent per fibre, not the statistic: MN scoring ran at 0.0010 s/fibre while ellrank timed out on 84 of 140 attempted fibres at the 8s/20s alarms

mestre_nagao_efficiency_measured.design: matched arms, same tier2 domain of 1548 specialisations, K=60 each; MN arm = top K by S(N), control arm = uniform random sample drawn with seed 81141
mestre_nagao_efficiency_measured.caveat: descent timeouts floor a fibre at rank 8 (the sections alone), so both arms' hit rates are LOWER bounds; the timeout counts are reported so the confound is visible
mestre_nagao_efficiency_measured.prior_measurement_referenced: GOAL-ECRANK-001 measured this statistic ordering poorly on twist families (nothing above rank 4 in the top 400 of 364756)

what_reaching_31_would_require: A base curve of rank roughly 18-20 over Q(t). This construction cannot supply it: the rational-elliptic-surface bound caps MW rank over Qbar(t) at 8, so the extra 10-12 requires a different surface (K3 or higher), not more sieving of this one.

Extra-over-base observed here was at most 4 (certified 12 from a base of 8) across 140 fibres on which descent was attempted. Reaching 31 from a base of 8 would require +23 from a single specialisation, which was not observed at any point in this search and is not a scale-up of anything measured here.
A per-fibre rank filter far cheaper than 2-descent. At the measured 7.5 s mean descent cost with an 8s alarm, certification -- not scoring -- is the binding cost; scoring ran 97640 fibres in 100 s.
explicitly_not_progress_toward_31: A certified rank of 12 from a rank-8 Q(t) base is not a fraction of the way to 31. The record ladder (28 -> 29 -> 30) rests on base ranks roughly 18-20; a rank-8 base is a different regime, not a smaller version of the same one.

tested_parameters_and_transfer_assumptio.family: one pencil, 8 base points with coordinates in [-4,4], chosen by a seeded search over 4000 configurations minimising MODEL HEIGHT only
tested_parameters_and_transfer_assumptio.solver: PARI/GP 2.15.4 ellrank (2-descent) with alarm guards; ellratpoints found nothing at bound 100 on these models
tested_parameters_and_transfer_assumptio.transfer: every number here is scoped to this single family and this domain; nothing is claimed for other pencils, other point configurations, or larger t
